method: Prepared WAVs checked with ElevenLabs Scribe v1 STT, cached wav2vec2-xlsr-53-espeak-cv-ft phoneme recognition, and a 10 ms RMS pause analysis. Phoneme model is imperfect; the recorded strings are evidence, not a human listening certificate.
paceDefinition: Whitespace-delimited script words divided by first-to-last audible speech span (includes internal clause pauses; excludes leading/trailing silence).
